column2: S01. Every individual has a responsibility to contribute positively to society.
column3: S02. Universities should encourage students to participate in community service activities.
column4: S03. New technologies should be evaluated for their societal impact before widespread deployment.
column5: S04. Technology companies should be accountable for unethical use of their platforms.
column6: S05. Individuals should have greater control over how their personal data are collected and used.
column7: S06. Combating online misinformation requires shared responsibility among users, platforms, and governments.
column8: S07. Equal opportunities should be prioritized regardless of a person's background.
column9: S08. Diverse teams generally make better decisions than homogeneous teams.
column10: S09. Universities should promote an inclusive environment where different viewpoints can be discussed respectfully.
column11: S10. Scientific evidence should play an important role in public policy decisions.
column12: S11. People should be free to express differing opinions as long as they do not promote harm or discrimination.
column13: S12. Young people should actively participate in addressing societal challenges.
column14: S13. Critical evaluation of online information should be taught as a core educational skill.
column15: S14. Leaders should prioritize ethical decision-making even when it reduces short-term gains.
column16: S15. Building public trust is essential for responsible adoption of emerging technologies.
